acme_oncall: Hey Redwood — since yesterday's auth-proxy rollout our Private VPC console shows 0s for per-tenant QPS/latency. App returns 200s and inference logs look normal. No tenant dimension in the console graphs.

morgan: Sorry — can you share the tenant id and an example request id? Also, did you notice any gateway errors?

acme_oncall: tenant: acme-prod-3, request id: req-9921. No gateway 5xx. We see the request hit model servers, but console metrics show no data for acme-prod-3.

sylvia: pinging ingress team — there was an auth-proxy change last night. ingress-bot, any deploys affecting headers?

ingress-bot: deploy: auth-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 rolled to private-ingress at 2025-11-02T03:12:00Z. Feature: replace-tenant-claim -> enabled.

rahul: quick hypothesis: telemetry enrichment expects tenant header x-tenant-id (or x-rw-tenant) to populate tenant dimension. New auth-proxy may be emitting tenant as x-auth-tenant (claim rename) which our sidecar filters out.

morgan: acme, can you run a curl against your gateway and paste the request headers (sanitized)? Example: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private-gw.acme.example/predict -v`

acme_oncall: here's a minimal request capture (sanitized):
```
> GET /predict HTTP/1.1
> Host: private-gw.acme.example
> Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
> X-Request-ID: req-9921
> X-Auth-Tenant: acme-prod-3
> User-Agent: acme-client/1.2
```

rahul: there it is — header name is X-Auth-Tenant. Telemetry sidecar enrichment only looks for x-tenant-id and x-rw-tenant (lowercase). The enrichment pipeline normalizes headers to lowercase and expects those specific keys. That explains the missing tenant dimension.

support-esc: I can repro locally by injecting X-Auth-Tenant into requests and watching telemetry enrichment drop the tenant label. Quick check commands for infra team: `kubectl -n private-ingress logs -l app=auth-proxy | grep -i X-Auth-Tenant` and `kubectl -n private-ingress logs -l app=telemetry-sidecar | grep tenant=`

morgan: thanks. We'll prepare a short-term config change to accept header aliases, and a long-term fix to make header aliasing configurable per-tenant.

acme_oncall: we can't change our token issuer to add x-tenant-id immediately. Can you add mapping on your side?

support-esc: creating internal ticket INF-2319: "private-ingress: accept x-auth-tenant header as tenant alias for telemetry enrichment" — linking this thread.

rahul: proposed patch (telemetry-sidecar config snippet):
```
header_aliases:
  x-tenant-id: ["x-auth-tenant", "x-tenant"]
  x-rw-tenant: ["x-auth-tenant"]
```
Apply to private-prod-ingress and staging first.

morgan: rolling patch to staging now (private-staging-ingress). Will monitor console.

ingress-bot: rollout started: telemetry-sidecar config patch INF-2319 -> private-staging-ingress.

support-esc: monitoring graphs for acme-prod-3 in staging — querying metrics-store with tenant label filter: `sum(rate(requests_total{tenant="acme-prod-3"}[5m]))`

rahul: staging shows replayed metrics for tenant after patch, tenant labels populated.

acme_oncall: any ETA for prod?

morgan: targeting prod patch in 30m after smoke checks. Will post when started.

support-esc: prod patch applied to private-prod-ingress at 1938765780. Waiting for metric pipeline catch-up.

sylvia: metrics showing up in console for acme-prod-3 now — graphs repopulating. acme, can you confirm on your side?

acme_oncall: confirmed — dashboard shows historical and live metrics again. Thx! :tada:

morgan: closing loop: root cause = auth-proxy rename of tenant claim -> new header name not whitelisted by telemetry enrichment. Remediation = header_aliases in telemetry-sidecar config + INF-2319 for a config-driven mapping and test coverage.

support-esc: notes added to customer ticket. Will follow up with postmortem + checklist for future auth-proxy header renames.

acme_oncall: appreciate the fast turnaround.

morgan: thanks everyone. Closing thread after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
